We present a foundation model for zero-shot metric monocular depth estimation. Our model, Depth Pro, synthesizes high-resolution depth maps with unparalleled sharpness and high-frequency details. And the model is fast, producing a 2.25-megapixel depth map in 0.3 seconds on a standard GPU. These characteristics are enabled by a number of technical contributions, including an efficient multi-scale vision transformer for dense prediction, a training protocol that combines…
The model in this repository is a reference implementation, which has been re-trained. Its performance is close to the model reported in the paper but does not match it exactly.

paragraphs: Joint video and soundtrack out of a single denoising pass, at bfloat16 with no quantization anywhere.

This Space is the denoising half: the 61.73 GiB transformer and the two autoencoders. The 62.14 GiB Qwen3-VL conditioner runs in qwen3vl-conditioner, which this Space calls over the gradio API for every request. The weights are the public MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 diffusers checkpoint.

paragraphs: Snap a photo of your meal, grocery label, or type a list of ingredients. NutriLens identifies each ingredient, looks up real nutritional data from the USDA, finds relevant scientific studies on PubMed, and delivers a clear per-ingredient health breakdown with proper citations.

Most of us buy food every day without really knowing what's in it or what it does to our bodies. Ingredient lists are full of names that sound foreign even in our own language - "sorbitol syrup," "soya lecithin," "emulsifier" - and nutrition science lives in dense academic papers most people will never read.

That gap matters: the foods we eat regularly shape our long-term health, and a lot of that influence is invisible until it's added up over years. repositories.name: PinkCherry MiniMax-H3 Demo
repositories.description: Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack

paragraphs: Joint video and soundtrack out of a single denoising pass, at bfloat16 with no quantization anywhere.

This Space is the denoising half: the 61.73 GiB transformer and the two autoencoders. The 62.14 GiB Qwen3-VL conditioner runs in qwen3vl-conditioner, which this Space calls over the gradio API for every request. The weights are the public MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 diffusers checkpoint.

MiniMax-H3 is 195.9 GiB in bfloat16 and a ZeroGPU Space is evicted at 150 GB of storage. An unquantized single Space is therefore impossible, which is why quantized demos of it run NVFP4 or float8 weights. Cut the MiniMaxH3Blocks sequence at its textencoder step and both halves fit unquantized:
